appName.description: Extension name shown in the store and browser UI.

appDescription.message: Copy or download the current AI conversation and its visible web sources as Markdown.

appTitle.description: Popup window title before the tab hostname is known.

titleOnSite.description: Popup window title once the tab hostname is known.

siteNameDefault.description: Header text before the active tab is read.

noActiveTab.description: Header text when there is no active tab.

actionsLabel.description: Accessibility label for the actions section.

feedbackLink.description: Footer link to the issue tracker.

statusReading.description: Status while the conversation is being collected.

statusCopiedOne.description: Status after copying a single message.

statusDownloadedOne.description: Status after downloading a single message.

statusNoTab.description: Status when there is no active tab.

statusUnsupported.message: Open a Claude, ChatGPT, or Grok conversation.

errorTabAccess.message: Could not access the active tab.
errorTabAccess.description: Status when the active tab cannot be read.

errorGeneric.description: Fallback status when an error has no message.

errorCollectorMissing.message: Could not start the conversation collector

errorPageUnavailable.description: Collection error: no page to read.

errorOpenConversation.message: Open a Claude, ChatGPT, or Grok conversation first

errorNoMessages.message: No conversation messages were available to export

errorGrokEmpty.description: Collection error: the Grok turn list was empty.

errorRequestFailed.description: Collection error: the site request failed.

errorNoResponse.description: Request failure detail when nothing was returned.

errorTimedOut.description: Collection error: the site request stalled.

shortcutDescription.description: Keyboard shortcut description shown in browser settings.
